description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Vikings have ruled out TE T.J. Hockenson for the remainder of the game against the Saints with a concussion.
items.impact: Hockenson went into the medical tent after his last reception and was quickly ruled out for the remainder of the game. He will finish the game with seven receiving yards on one reception. Gavin Bartholomew will serve as the primary tight end for the remainder of the game.
items.title: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) ruled out

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Eagles RB Will Shipley is questionable to return against the Jaguars with a foot injury.
items.impact: Shipley was injured on his last carry and went to the locker room for further evaluation. Dameon Pierce will handle the bulk of the carries with Shipley questionable to return.
items.title: Will Shipley (foot) questionable to return

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: J.J. McCarthy is active for Week 5 for the New York Giants against the Washington Commanders according to Jordan Raanan.
items.impact: McCarthy will serve as the backup quarterback for head coach John Harbaugh, with Jameis Winston once against starting under center in Week 5 against the Commanders.
items.title: J.J. McCarthy active for Week 5

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Odell Beckham Jr. is inactive for Week 5 for the Minnesota Vikings against the New Orleans Saints according to Tom Pelissero.
items.impact: Beckham Jr. will not suit up after being elevated from the practice squad, joining Jordan Addison (hamstring) on the sidelines, while Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jauan Jennings operate as the top two wideouts against the Saints for head coach Kevin O'Connell Sunday.
items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. inactive for Week 5

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is inactive for Week 5 for the Chicago Bears against the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Williams will sit out once again for head coach Ben Johnson in hopes of returning in Week 6, with Tyson Bagent once against behind center against the Packers Sunday.
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) inactive for Week 5

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Colts WR Keenan Allen (groin) is officially active for a Week 5 matchup with the Steelers.
items.impact: Allen continues to deal with a nagging groin injury, but is cleared to suit up against Pittsburgh. With Allen active, Darius Slayton is a healthy inactive.
items.title: Keenan Allen (groin) officially active for Week 5

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (back) is active for Week 5 for the New Orleans Saints against the Minnesota Vikings according to James Palmer.
items.impact: Kamara is good to go after passing through pregame tests on his back, boosting a New Orleans backfield attack that faces a stiff test against an aggressive Minnesota defensive front Sunday.
items.title: Alvin Kamara (back) active for Week 5

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Dolphins WR Caleb Douglas (ankle) is officially inactive for a Week 5 matchup with the Bengals.
items.impact: Douglas was considered a long shot to play Sunday as he continues to recover from an ankle injury. Jalen Tolbert will likely see an increase in playing time with Douglas sidelined.
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) officially inactive for Week 5

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (toe) is officially inactive for a Week 5 matchup with the Colts.
items.impact: Dowdle was considered questionable to play, but will miss another week with a toe injury he suffered in Week 2. Jaylen Warren should receive the bulk of the carries against the Colts.
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) officially inactive for Week 5

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is officially active for a Week 5 matchup with the Raiders.
items.impact: Stevenson was rolled up on late in the Patriots' win last week, but appears to be good to go against Las Vegas in Week 5. Fantasy managers should expect the Patriots to continue to operate a split backfield with Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson.
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) officially active for Week 5

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty (foot/ankle) is active for Week 5 for the Las Vegas Raiders against the New England Patriots according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Jeanty is good to go after testing his injured foot and ankle during pregame warmups, offering head coach Klint Kubiak is dynamic backfield option against the Patriots Sunday.
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (foot/ankle) active for Week 5

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 5 matchup with the Giants.
items.impact: McLaurin was considered a game-time decision, but he was cleared to play after pregame warmups. The Commanders are without Stefon Diggs (hamstring) so McLaurin's return to the lineup will be a much needed boost.
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially active for Week 5

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Jordan Addison (hamstring) is inactive for Week 5 for the Minnesota Vikings against the New Orleans Saints according to Tom Pelissero.
items.impact: Addison will not suit up after struggling to progress throughout the week for head coach Kevin O'Connell, while No. 1 wideout Justin Jefferson (ankle) is good to go for the Week 5 contest against the Saints.
items.title: Jordan Addison (hamstring) inactive for Week 5

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Titans WR Carnell Tate (back) is officially active for a Week 5 matchup with Houston.
items.impact: Tate was considered questionable after being limited in practice Thursday and Friday. He will suit up and provide the Titans with their best option at wide receiver against Houston.
items.title: Carnell Tate (back) officially active for Week 5

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) is officially active for the Minnesota Vikings against the New Orleans Saints according to Tom Pelissero.
items.impact: Jefferson is good to go after not experiencing any issues in pregame activities for head coach Kevin O'Connell, and is is in line for a sizeable workload with Jordan Addison sidelined against the Saints.
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) active for Week 5

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) is cleared to play for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Miami Dolphins Sunday.
items.impact: Chase was able to clear through concussion protocols ahead of the Week 5 contest, offering quarterback Joe Burrow both of his explosive pass-catching options along with Tee Higgins (groin/neck) against the Dolphins Sunday.
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) to play Sunday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) will play for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Miami Dolphins Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Higgins is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation, joining Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) back in the Cincinnati passing attack against the Dolphins Sunday.
items.title: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) will play Sunday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Zay Flowers (foot) is expected to play on Sunday against the Falcons and push through his foot injury.
items.impact: If Flowers suits up, he will provide backup QB Tyler Huntley with a more than capable target downfield in a Ravens passing attack that lacks much punch behind him. He will be needed to prevent the offense from being one-dimensional, especially with the Falcons offense picking up steam since the return of Michael Penix.
items.title: Zay Flowers (foot) expected to play on Sunday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot) is not expected to play on Sunday against Denver due to a foot injury.
items.impact: It's a tough blow to the Chargers' chances of winning if Ladd sits, as they are already down Quentin Johnston. Tre Harris is the next man up for LA, and he could see a decent amount of work and be a flex-worthy option, especially with Denver missing two of their top corners this week.
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) not expected to play against Denver

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard (ankle) is inactive for Week 5 for the Philadelphia Eagles against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Greenard was unable to pass through pregame warmups enough to get the green light to suit up for head coach Nick Sirianni, leaving the Philadelphia defensive front shorthanded against the Jaguars Sunday.
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (ankle) inactive for Week 5

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Hollywood Brown (ankle) is inactive for Week 5 for the Philadelphia Eagles against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Brown joins fellow wideout Devonta Smith and running back Saquon Barkley on the sidelines for head coach Nick Sirianni, leaving Makai Lemon and Dontayvion Wicks as the primary pass-catching options against the Jaguars Sunday.
items.title: Hollywood Brown (ankle) inactive for Week 5

title: Fantasy Player News
